articles.title: India rolls out new gold math with import duty tax hike. Who will foot the bill?
articles.summary: India is significantly hiking prices for precious metals, increasing import duties, to shield the rupee from the economic repercussions of the Middle East conflict. This strategic move aims to curb non-essential imports, reduce the current account deficit, and stabilize the national currency. It demonstrates India's proactive approach to managing economic stability amidst global geopolitical challenges, crucial for national financial resilience.

articles.title: CBSE Class 12th Results 2026 Declared: Girls performs better than boys by 6.73%
articles.summary: Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has declared the Class 12 Board examination results today, May 13. This significant announcement allows students nationwide to access their marks, a crucial juncture for their higher education and career aspirations. For SSB aspirants, these results mark a key academic milestone influencing future opportunities and pathways towards their defence career goals.

articles.title: Pixel art 2.5D narrative adventure Beyond the Plastic Wall announced for PC
articles.summary: "Beyond the Plastic Wall" introduces players to Hal, a young scavenger character. The game's premise revolves around Hal discovering a sealed box of mysterious letters. These letters are penned by an unknown woman residing deep within formidable walls. This narrative-driven experience promises a journey of uncovering secrets and exploration, immersing players in a unique world of discovery through its intriguing storyline.

articles.title: The Missing Navies: The Hormuz Crisis and the Limits of America’s Indo-Pacific Partnerships
articles.summary: On May 4, 2026, a South Korean vessel was attacked in the Strait of Hormuz, prompting U.S. President Donald Trump to urge Seoul to join a U.S.-led operation. This initiative aims to secure the critical waterway, highlighting the importance of international cooperation in maritime security. The incident underscores global efforts to maintain stability in strategic shipping lanes and reinforce alliances against threats.

articles.title: Pakistan inducts new Chinese submarine, puts focus on India’s undersea strength and pace
articles.summary: The Pakistani Navy has commissioned its first Chinese-built Hangor-class submarine, PNS Hangor, at Sanya on China's Hainan Island. This marks a significant milestone as it's the first of eight such vessels Pakistan is acquiring from China. The acquisition strengthens Pakistan's naval capabilities and underscores deepening defence cooperation between the two countries, impacting regional maritime security dynamics.

articles.title: 22k gold rates rise by up to 9% today: Check 24k, 22k, 18k gold prices (May 13, 2026) on IBJA, Malabar Gold & Diamonds, Joyalukkas, Tanishq and Kalyan Jewellers
articles.summary: Gold prices surged across major jewellery brands after the central government significantly increased customs duty on gold from 6% to 15%. This decisive policy move aims to discourage surging gold imports, which often strain the national economy and current account deficit. SSB aspirants should note how government economic measures directly influence market dynamics and national trade balances.

articles.title: Pakistan’s New Logic of Limited War May Not Keep War Limited
articles.summary: The article outlines a hypothetical May 2025 scenario depicting Indian BrahMos missile strikes on Pakistani air bases, targeting runways, aircraft, and critical infrastructure. This imagined event would force Islamabad to make a crucial decision regarding its response capabilities. The scenario emphasizes the destructive potential of advanced weaponry and the complex strategic choices nations face in regional security contexts, highlighting the intricacies of potential future conflicts.

articles.title: A rare Navy photo revealed the location of a nuclear-missile submarine amid Iran tensions
articles.summary: An Ohio-class US ballistic-missile submarine arrived in Gibraltar on Monday, a strategic deployment amidst persistent tensions with Iran. This rare and significant move by the US Navy signals a show of force and deterrence, highlighting America's commitment to maintaining security and projecting power in international waters, especially given the geopolitical climate.
